cd /workspace/project && python3 - <<'PY'
import re
s=open('/tmp/am.js',errors='ignore').read()
# cari pemanggilan b3( (fungsi claim anonim) dan sumber claimToken
for m in list(re.finditer(r'b3\(',s))[:6]:
    print(f"[call b3] {re.sub(r'\\s+',' ',s[max(0,m.start()-400):m.start()+200])}\n")
print('='*70)
for kw in ['claim_token','claimToken:','claim=']:
    for m in list(re.finditer(re.escape(kw),s))[:3]:
        print(f"[{kw}] {re.sub(r'\\s+',' ',s[max(0,m.start()-250):m.start()+250])}\n")
PY
